name: demo-triage
description: Demo read-only triage of the "receipt photos come out sideways" intake ticket: declares a short diagnosis plan, inspects the code with Glob, Grep and Read only, reports a diagnosis with confidence 0.86 and closes its plan without touching a file.

tasks.title: Trace how receipt uploads are normalised
Confirm the root cause against the upload tests

steps.thinking: normalizeImage re-encodes to JPEG and strips metadata, but never applies the EXIF orientation first.

args.root_cause: normalizeImage() re-encodes uploads and strips all metadata without applying the EXIF orientation tag first, so portrait photos taken on phones are stored rotated 90 degrees.
args.fix_plan: Apply the EXIF orientation before stripping metadata in src/uploads/normalize.ts, add a regression test with a rotated fixture, then verify on UAT with the reporter's receipt.

evidence.detail: The existing test covers metadata stripping but no rotated input: the gap that let this through

steps.text: Diagnosis reported (confidence 0.86). No file was changed.
